comments.snippet:
This report came from 1.82.0 (Release 3593). It is the same crash as #209, #220 and #224: `ComboBox.OnFontChanged` while a window moves to a monitor with a different scale.

1.82.0 has neither repair. The current nightly `1.84.0+e5672682ff` has both: after a DPI change it gives the Quick Connect box its window back, and since yesterday it does that even when the font work before it fails. The crash report also gains a `Win32 error:` line. Download: https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/relea...
